item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Monitoring via Alerts
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports Azure Monitor alerts in general availability. You can create alert rules on HorizonDB metrics, set thresholds, and receive notifications when conditions are met.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Public monitoring alerts now have direct links
item.description:
Public monitoring alerts in an enterprise’s Public monitoring view now support direct links to individual alerts. Clicking an alert number opens that alert directly.

  • Source: GitHub
